presets.name: Sepia
presets.summary: A warm brown grid on tanned paper.
presets.description: The style has one color group for the whole grid, so a single palette change carries the picture.

presets.name: Greyscale
presets.description: No hue anywhere, which suits an identicon: the pattern carries the identity, not the color.

presets.name: Duotone
presets.summary: One indigo on a pale indigo ground.
presets.description: Background and grid take the same hue at two lightnesses. The most restrained this style gets, and the easiest to place next to an existing brand color.

presets.name: Muted
presets.summary: Dusty tones instead of the full spectrum.
presets.description: The style ships nineteen colors around the wheel. This trades them for six dusty tones, which stops a table of identicons looking like a test chart.

presets.name: Electric
presets.description: The other direction on the same lever: six colors past anything the style ships, on a dark background so they read as lit.

presets.name: Pastel Wall
presets.description: Changes only what the grid sits on. The lightest way to make a set of avatars feel like it belongs together.

presets.name: Bold Pop
presets.description: The loud counterpart to Pastel Wall, strong enough that the avatar holds its own against a busy page.

presets.name: Sunrise
presets.summary: A warm gradient behind the shapes.
presets.description: Shows the gradient background options: two colors, a linear fill and a fixed angle. The seed still decides which of the two ends up on top.
